cards.title: Images with
cards.body: `` shows a picture. `src` is the address of the picture. It has no closing tag.

cards.title: Always write alt text
cards.body: `alt` describes the picture for people who can't see it, and shows when the picture fails to load.

check.question: What is `alt` for?
options: Describing the picture for people who can't see it
check.explanation: Screen readers read the `alt` text aloud, and browsers show it when the picture is missing.

exercise.prompt: Add an image with any `src`, and an `alt` that describes it.
exercise.starterCode: My pet
